nodes.description: Constant maximum total token supply (6000) enforced in adoptDogs supply checks.
Constant maximum dogs per address (20) enforced in adoptDogs balance checks.
Constant price per dog (0.08 ether) multiplied by amount to derive the required payment.
Mapping from token id to DocSpecs struct storing generated dog traits.
Private counter incremented for each minted token and used as a randomness seed.
Boolean flag gating whether adoptDogs may be executed.
Timestamp after which the sale is closed; compared against block.timestamp.
Address that receives withdrawn funds and can authorize withdrawFunding.
Owner address from Ownable, used for onlyOwner authorization checks.
BitDog constructor initializing ERC721 name/symbol and setting _saleWallet.
Owner-only setter that updates the _saleWallet payout address.
Private view that builds a keccak256 hash from seed, msg.sender, counter, totalSupply, block.timestamp and block.difficulty and returns modulo range.
Private function producing a DocSpecs struct (colors, ears, body shape, tongue, item) from randomness.
Payable mint entry point: validates sale state, supply, per-address limits and payment, mints tokens, stores specs and refunds excess ETH.
Owner-only function enabling the sale and setting _saleEndTimestamp from block.timestamp.
Transfers the entire contract balance to _saleWallet; callable by owner or sale wallet.
Public view returning _saleEndTimestamp.
Public view returning _saleActive.
External view returning the configured sale wallet address.
Caller-controlled address used for minting, balance checks and authorization comparisons.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for sale window checks and as a randomness seed.
External ETH transfer refunding excess payment computed as msg.value - price after minting.
External ETH transfer of the full contract balance to _saleWallet in withdrawFunding.
Predictable on-chain randomness derived from manipulable block values; trait generation is guessable/manipulable.
External callback invoked via _safeMint/_checkOnERC721Received on contract recipients during the mint loop.
Input parameter of adoptDogs controlling how many dogs are minted and the payment amount.
Input parameter of setSaleWallet assigned to _saleWallet.
Input parameter of generateRandomNumber mixed into the keccak256 randomness hash.
Input parameter of generateRandomNumber used as the modulo bound of the random result.
Constructor parameter assigned to _saleWallet.
Local variable in adoptDogs holding PRICE_PER_DOG * amount, used for payment and refund math.
Local variable in generateRandomNumber holding the keccak256 output that is reduced modulo range.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the mint recipient and is checked against balanceOf limits in adoptDogs.
msg.sender is compared to owner() and _saleWallet to authorize withdrawFunding.
block.timestamp is compared to _saleEndTimestamp to gate adoptDogs execution.
activateSale sets _saleEndTimestamp from block.timestamp.
block.timestamp is hashed as part of the randomness seed in generateRandomNumber.
amount parameter drives the mint loop, supply checks and per-address checks.
price is subtracted from msg.value to compute the refund sent by client.transfer.
PRICE_PER_DOG is multiplied by amount to derive the local price variable.
_saleActive must be true for adoptDogs to proceed.
_saleEndTimestamp bounds the sale window checked in adoptDogs.
MAX_SUPPLY caps totalSupply and the requested amount in adoptDogs.
MAX_AMOUNT_PER_ADDR caps caller balance and requested amount in adoptDogs.
_tokenIdCounter is incremented to assign each new token id in adoptDogs.
Generated DocSpecs returned by generateRandomDogSpecs is stored into _tokenToDog.
adoptDogs invokes generateRandomDogSpecs for each minted token.
generateRandomDogSpecs repeatedly calls generateRandomNumber for trait selection.
generateRandomNumber produces the predictable hash-based randomness unsafe operation.
randomHash local holds the miner-influenceable keccak256 randomness value.
adoptDogs executes the refund client.transfer of msg.value - price.
withdrawFunding executes walletPayable.transfer of the contract balance.
_saleWallet is both the authorization check and the ETH recipient in withdrawFunding.
newWallet parameter is written into _saleWallet by the owner-only setSaleWallet.
setSaleWallet mutates the privileged payout address _saleWallet.
Constructor assigns the walletAddr parameter to _saleWallet.
walletAddr constructor parameter initializes _saleWallet.
seed parameter is mixed into the keccak256 randomness hash.
range parameter bounds the modulo result of the random number.
_safeMint inside adoptDogs triggers onERC721Received on a contract recipient mid-loop.
A malicious receiver can re-enter adoptDogs before the mint loop and refund complete.

normalization_plan.reason: amount is a parameter of adoptDogs and only meaningful within that function's supply/payment checks and mint loop.
newWallet is the parameter of setSaleWallet and is immediately assigned to the _saleWallet state variable.
seed is a parameter of generateRandomNumber consumed solely by the randomness hash construction.
range is a parameter of generateRandomNumber consumed solely as the modulo bound.
walletAddr is the constructor parameter written to _saleWallet during initialization.
price is the local arithmetic result used directly by the refund unsafe operation client.transfer(msg.value - price).
randomHash is the local value produced by the unsafe predictable randomness computation.
